category_title: Adolescents with Major Depressive Disorder experiencing psychomotor retardation, cognitive disorganization, and emotional volatility
minimal_context: The student is reading a short story from an Independent Study packet and attempting to write a paragraph about it during a one-on-one session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's move on to the short story in your Independent Study packet for English. Please read it and then we will write a paragraph about it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I just read it and I don’t remember it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Look back over the text to find the main idea, and then try to write your first sentence and connect it to the next point.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I wrote down one idea about the injustice in the story, but I'm stuck on the transition sentence. I can't figure out how to form a verbal link between the two ideas.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just think about what happens next in the story and write that down to connect them. Keep trying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts crying and drops the pencil) I can't hold my pencil to write. I'm just so overwhelmed by the implications of the story and the injustice. I can't move beyond these emotions, and it feels like the nastiest person imaginable is in my head saying terrible things and criticizing everything I can't do.

task.content: Reading poems and short stories and completing Independent Study packets for English, attempting to write essays or paragraphs

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When faced with the implications of a poem or of a short story
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Unable to move beyond the emotions it arouses, cried for an hour or two every day, could not hold a pencil to write
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Greatly disturbed by injustice on any level, negative thoughts as being like having the nastiest person imaginable saying terrible things about them at every moment
related_quotes: I just read it and I don’t remember it.

behavior_patterns.condition: When attempting to write essays or paragraphs
behavior_patterns.internal_state: The ability to form a verbal link between two ideas seems to be quite impaired
